newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville chief Randy Hardy resigns as of October.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville chief Randy Hardy resigns as of October.

text.p: Bonneville Power Administrator Randy Hardy told employees of the federal power marketing agency Thursday he has resigned his post, effective on or around October 1.

Hardy, who has headed the agency since 1991, said in a statment he was resigning to spend more time with his family. Bonneville is headquartered in Portland, Oregon, while Hardy's family is located in Seattle, Washington.
The Department of Energy is expected to name his replacement.
Hardy said Bonneville faces a number of challenging issues, but the region is moving ahead in a coordinated effort to define the agency's role and recent steps have assured stability through 2001.
